name: King University
academic_ranking: Private Presbyterian-affiliated university (founded 1867) in Bristol, TN. Accredited by SACSCOC. Enrollment approximately 1,357 (Fall 2022). Offers 80+ undergraduate majors, minors, and pre-professional programs plus graduate degrees (MBA, MSW, M.Ed., MSN) and a Doctorate of Nursing Practice. No specific national ranking confirmed from public sources.
financial_aid: King University awards over $19 million in financial aid annually to the majority of students, with an average annual award of about $20,336. Aid types include grants, scholarships, work-study, federal/state assistance, and loans. FAFSA federal school code 003496. Financial Aid Office: financialaid@king.edu, 423-652-4725. Exact published tuition figure not located on official pages as of 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Athletics site references general athletics facilities; no dedicated softball home field/stadium name published on the softball program or roster pages as of 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in Conference Carolinas. No specific softball championships or honors detailed on the public program page as of 2026-07.
